{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Scout XX-298-B''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The scout surveyed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fyodos]], and discovered the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] population, the [[Fyodoi]], and found out they were the remnants of a formerly technologically advanced civilization. The scout also had a run in with a member of the [[Galidyn]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
